lessons_text:
Lessons from earlier sessions in this repository (they were written after a failure was fixed; check each against the code before relying on it):
L1. When adding a new operation to src/ops/ in the ledger repo: Create the test alongside it at tests/ops/<name>.spec.ts, not tests/<name>.spec.ts; the house-rules pretest enforces one test file per operation, and imports from there need ../../src/.... (seen: npm test failed with "src/ops/vat.ts has no test file tests/ops/vat.spec.ts", then passed after moving the test and fixing its relative import.)
